kjv: Thou wilt keep him in perfect peace, whose mind is stayed on thee: because he trusteth in thee.

lines.say: Good morning. Mind racing already? Hear this.
Thou wilt keep him in perfect peace, whose mind is stayed on thee: because he trusteth in thee. Isaiah twenty six, verse three.
lines.big: Thou wilt keep him in perfect peace, whose mind is stayed on thee: because he trusteth in thee.

lines.say: Peace isn't the absence of problems. It's keeping your mind on him while you've got them.
lines.big: Peace isn't the absence of problems. It's keeping your mind on him while you've got them.

lines.say: Lord, keep my mind on you today, and keep me in your peace. In Jesus' name, amen.
